definition_zh: 祸根；毒物；克星；造成痛苦之源
definition_en: a cause of harm, death, or misery; a poison
core_image: 毒草挂在名字后面：谁碰谁遭殃
scene: 园丁指着一丛白色毒芹摇头叹息。Wolfsbane is the bane of grazing cattle.
sceneCN: 这里 bane 指「毒物、克星」（第 2 个义项：致害之物）；句意：狼毒乌头是吃草牛的克星。

collocations.zh: 令我深恶痛绝之物；克星

senses.title: A cause of ruin or misery
senses.definition: something that constantly causes trouble or suffering
senses.definitionCN: 不断带来麻烦或痛苦的东西
senses.example: Noise became the bane of her life.
senses.exampleCN: 噪音成了她一生的祸根。
senses.why: Old English bana meant a slayer; the slayer softens into the tormentor.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 bana 意为「杀戮者」；杀戮者渐弱化为折磨者。

senses.title: A poison
senses.definition: a poison that kills, especially of plants
senses.example: Hemlock was the bane of Socrates.
senses.exampleCN: 毒芹是苏格拉底的死亡之毒。
senses.why: The literal slayer is the poison itself.
senses.whyCN: 字面上的「杀戮者」即毒物本身。

senses.title: In plant names
senses.definition: a second element in names of poisonous plants, as wolfsbane and henbane
senses.definitionCN: 毒草名称的后缀成分，如 wolfsbane、henbane
senses.why: Old herbals labeled each poison by its victim: wolf's bane kills wolves.
senses.whyCN: 古老草药书按受害者命名毒草：狼之毒、母鸡之毒。

senses.title: A natural enemy
senses.definition: the thing or person that reliably defeats another
senses.definitionCN: 总能克制对手的事物或人
senses.example: Quick wits are the bane of a bully.
senses.why: What kills the wolf becomes what defeats the type.
senses.whyCN: 能杀狼之物引申为能克制其类者。

senses.title: The adjective baneful
senses.definitionCN: 效果上有害的、毁灭性的
senses.example: Baneful habits crept into his routine.
senses.exampleCN: 有害的习惯悄悄潜入他的日常。
senses.why: The suffix -ful turns the poison into a quality.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -ful 把毒物化为性质。

senses.title: Literary ruin
senses.definition: destruction or death in elevated or old-fashioned style
senses.definitionCN: 书面或古雅语体中的毁灭、死亡
senses.example: The poet sang of the hero's bane.
senses.why: Epic verse kept the old slaying word alive.
senses.whyCN: 史诗韵文让古老的杀戮词存活下来。

senses.title: Compound with things and vermin
senses.definition: compounds naming pest killers, as ratsbane and bugbane
senses.definitionCN: 指杀灭害虫之物的复合词，如 ratsbane、bugbane
senses.example: Ratsbane was scattered in the granary.
senses.why: The naming pattern of plant names spread to pest poisons.
senses.whyCN: 毒草命名模式扩展到灭害之毒。

senses.title: Ironical everyday use
senses.definition: a jocular way to blame a minor annoyance
senses.definitionCN: 戏谑地归咎于小烦恼的说法
senses.example: Monday mornings are the bane of my existence.
senses.exampleCN: 周一早晨是我命中克星。
senses.why: Grand ruin shrunk to comic complaint.
senses.whyCN: 宏大的毁灭缩成喜剧式的抱怨。

intro.en: Bane goes back to Old English bana, a slayer, from a Germanic root meaning to kill; the poison sense and the tormentor sense both grow from the killer.
intro.cn: bane 源自古英语 bana「杀戮者」，出日耳曼语「杀」之词根；「毒物」与「折磨者」二义皆由「杀者」生出。

items.en: A Germanic verb *banon meant to kill, to slay.
items.cn: 原始日耳曼动词 *banon 意为杀、戮。

items.en: bana named a slayer, murderer, or the devil as the murderer of souls.
items.cn: 古英语 bana 指杀人者，亦指谋害灵魂的魔鬼。

items.en: The word came to mean poison, as in ratsbane and henbane.
items.cn: 中古英语转指毒物，如 ratsbane、henbane。

items.en: Poetry kept the ruin sense; herbals kept the plant compounds.
items.cn: 诗歌保留毁灭义；草药书保留植物复合词。

items.en: Today the word lives chiefly in the phrase the bane of, a fixed complaint.
items.cn: 现代英语中该词主要存活于 the bane of 的固定抱怨句式。

note.en: Group one holds the slayer family and look-alikes; group two holds the harm field.
note.cn: 第一组收「杀戮」词族与形近词；第二组收「为害」义场。

entries.definition: a prohibition; spelled shorter, from a different Germanic verb.
entries.definitionCN: 禁令；拼写更短，出自另一日耳曼动词。

entries.definition: worn-out from common use; kin to ban, not to bane.
entries.definitionCN: 陈腐的；与 ban 同族，与 bane 无关。

entries.definition: a substance that kills or harms.

normalIntro.en: bane is the old slayer: first it killed bodies, now it kills peace of mind.
normalIntro.cn: bane 是古老的杀戮者：先杀身，如今诛心。

normal.cn: 词根：古英语 bana「杀戮者」。
植物名：狼毒乌头、天仙子。

normal.en: Phrase: the bane of my existence.
normal.cn: 短语：the bane of my existence。

abstract.en: See the white flowers of wolfsbane nodding by the path.
abstract.cn: 看路旁狼毒乌头白色的花在点头。

abstract.en: Bane is the pebble in the shoe that walks with you forever.
abstract.cn: bane 是鞋里那颗与你同行一生的石子。

abstract.en: Hear the same complaint every Monday: my bane again.
abstract.cn: 听每个周一的同一句抱怨：克星又来了。

examples.en: Mosquitoes are the bane of summer camping.
examples.cn: 蚊子是夏季露营的祸根。

examples.en: Medieval herbalists wrote of henbane and wolf's bane alike.
examples.cn: 中世纪草药学家对天仙子与狼毒乌头一并记载。

examples.en: His baneful influence spread through the committee.
examples.cn: 他的恶劣影响蔓延至整个委员会。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「贝恩」——含着「祸」音：贝恩一来，霉运缠身

root: 出自古英语 bana「杀戮者」，溯至原始日耳曼语 *banon「杀」；中古英语由「杀者」转指「毒物」，近代英语又引申为「祸根、克星」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow the slayer as he weakens: literal poison, plant names, the natural enemy, the adjective, literary ruin, pest compounds, and the comic complaint.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项追踪「杀戮者」的弱化过程：实体毒物、植物名、克星、形容词、文学化毁灭、灭害复合词，以及戏谑抱怨。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the slayer hiding behind a small word.
core.cn: 核心意象：藏在小词身后的杀戮者。

branches.en: The poison becomes the unbeatable enemy.
branches.cn: 毒物变成打不败的克星。

branches.en: Literature and pest compounds keep the old strength.
branches.cn: 文学与灭害复合词保留旧日之力。

branches.en: From great ruin to Monday-morning complaint.
branches.cn: 从大毁灭到周一早晨的抱怨。

intro.en: The bane family is small: one Germanic root of killing with a few compounds and an adjective.
intro.cn: bane 词族很小：一个日耳曼「杀」根，加数个复合词与一个形容词。

latinIntro.en: No Latin kin exist; the line is purely Germanic, so the Latin table stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 无拉丁同源词，词线纯出日耳曼语，拉丁同族表留空。

items.example: wolf's bane in the herb garden
